title: System Context diagram for rustinfer
intro: rustinfer and the people and systems around it. The people are the SRS user classes that touch the product (SRS §2.3); kernel and backend authors work on the source, not with the system, and are left out.

people.name: Builder
people.desc: Produces and inspects artifacts, chooses profiles and precision, runs the autotuner.

people.name: Operator
people.desc: Runs the executor or the server; reads metrics and health.

people.name: Client
people.desc: Sends requests through the library, the CLI or HTTP.

people.name: CI
people.desc: Builds, lints and tests on every change; autotunes on hardware runners.

system.name: rustinfer
system.desc: Compiles a Hugging Face checkpoint into a hashed engine artifact for one target, then loads it, streams the weights to the device and serves tokens.

externals.name: Hugging Face checkpoint directory
externals.desc: The model's weights and configuration, read in place and never copied into the artifact.

externals.name: ROCm driver and AMD GPU
externals.desc: Holds the weights and runs the generated kernels.

externals.name: Host CPU
externals.desc: Runs the compiler and the CPU reference target every GPU result is checked against.

externals.name: LLVM 23 toolchain
externals.tech: MLIR, AMDGPU backend, lld; linked in process
externals.desc: Lowers Kernel IR to AMDGPU code objects (ADR-007).

externals.name: RISC-V boards
externals.desc: Later targets: vector cores first, then meshes.

relations.label: runs and serves a model; reads health
sends requests, receives tokens
relations.tech: library enqueue/await; HTTP and SSE from R3

relations.label: builds and tests every change; autotunes
reads the configuration, the shard headers and the used byte ranges
streams weights, loads code objects, launches kernels
